cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Could you hold this shelf bracket against the holes? It keeps slipping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Could you turn that top screw once? Then you can let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are already lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just tighten those, then? And slide the shelf onto it to check. I'll get your coat.

mechanism: A grants brief help and release in tiny approved increments until B has completed most of the shelf installation.
confusable: Ordinary delegation hands over the task openly; this Drive requires small favors accumulating, with S01 controlling when B is allowed to finish.
comparison: A time-limited helper handles progressively more installation; the bouquet alternative uses helpful diagnosis to transfer finishing work.
seedUse: Use D25-a bracket, one screw and aligned remaining screws; S01 turns requests to leave into conditional release.
